selected.title: The Delivery Driver Exposed His Secret Apartment
selected.hook: His food delivery driver is how I discovered my boyfriend had a second apartment.
selected.voiceover:
His food delivery driver is how I discovered my boyfriend had a second apartment.

We'd been together for three years, and for the last six months he kept saying work was getting brutal. Two late nights became four. Weekends started disappearing too.

On Saturday, while he was supposedly at the office, my phone rang. A delivery driver asked if I could buzz him into an apartment building across town. I said he had the wrong number.

Then he read back my boyfriend's full name and said, "You're the contact on the order."

I drove there instead of calling him.

His car was outside.

I waited across the street until he walked out carrying groceries with a woman I'd never seen. They weren't kissing. Honestly, that almost made it worse. They looked normal. Comfortable. Like they'd done this a hundred times.

I called him while I was watching.

He answered and whispered, "I'm still at work. I'll call you later."

So I said, "No problem. I'm across the street."

He froze.

Apparently the apartment belonged to his "friend," and he was only helping her because she was going through a breakup.

He says nothing physical ever happened.

But you don't need a second relationship to cheat, right? How would you even believe him after that?
